reports="$RUNNER_TEMP/windows-coverage"
destination="$reports/packages/computer-use/coverage/native-windows"
mkdir -p "$destination"
set -- "$reports"/windows-*
if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo '::error::Expected exactly one Windows coverage producer directory'
  exit 1
fi
cp "$1"/{lcov.info,coverage.json,metadata.json} "$destination/"
uv run --locked --project tests/integration python scripts/coverage_accounting.py \
  --os win32 --base "$BASE" --reports-root "$reports" --summary coverage/windows-x64-summary.json
